bio.text: Dave Bushaw, a 31-year-old Hawkeye resident as of November 2025, announced he would run as an independent candidate for Iowa's 2nd Congressional District in 2026.

According to Iowa Capital Dispatch, he worked as an organizer for Bernie Sanders' presidential campaign in 2019 and 2020 in Iowa, Nevada and South Carolina, and then for United Today, Stronger Tomorrow, an organization focused on political organizing in rural communities.
His campaign website says he started a squash farm in Hawkeye called Solidarity Fields at age 19, and that he has performed as a folk musician at labor union strikes.

sources.title: Independent candidate Dave Bushaw joins Iowa 2nd Congressional District race
